description: Queue the durable server-side judge — it snapshots the exact authored target, samples eval beats, captures frames asynchronously, and grades editorial/spatial/brand/caption. Then wait_job(kind="verify", id=jobId) for per-criterion scores, weighted composite, worst-first critique, and checkpointId. `body.composition` is optional (absent ⇒ ACTIVE). Fix the lowest criterion via apply_composition and re-score. Idempotent per immutable snapshot; compose_verify bills only on the guarded success terminal.

composition.description: The composition to judge. Absent ⇒ the project's ACTIVE composition.

compositionId.description: Judge a SPECIFIC persisted composition of this project (create_render parity). Absent ⇒ the active one. A stale/foreign id is a 404 — never a silent fall-through.

session_id.description: Compose-session id: judge that session's SCRATCH composition (what the session has been editing) instead of the active row. Ignored when `composition` is passed.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: score_composition

jobKey.description: Deterministic identity of the work (content hash of every input the result depends on). Re-enqueueing the same key returns the same job while it runs; a failed key revives as a fresh attempt.

status.description: running on a fresh/deduped enqueue; succeeded when an identical request already completed. Cancelled is part of the shared status vocabulary; identical cancelled work revives to running.

title: Score Composition
